:::{#def-validation-set}
#### Validation set

The **validation set** of a [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits)
is the [held-out set](#def-held-out-set) of observations indexed by $\validx$,
used to choose among candidate [fitted models](#def-fitted-model)
fitted to the training set:

$$
\paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \validx}.
$$ {#eq-validation-set}

:::
